$comment: Project files this plugin supplies, for `kit doctor` and `/kit-adopt` (core). Besides these, every agent in agents/ counts as kit-owned automatically; this plugin's slash commands live in commands/, so they are listed here under both project spellings. A project hook in .claude/settings.json that runs one of `hookScripts` duplicates a kit hook. git-branch-context, shell-edits and the shell-deletions hook are core's.

partial.scripts/hooks/hook-utils.mjs: The ledger helpers in it are the plugin's; other project hooks may still import the rest, so retire it only when nothing imports it.
partial.scripts/hooks/scan-ledger-secrets.mjs: A git hook manager (lefthook, husky) may still call it, and plugin commands are not on PATH there: add this repo as a dev dependency (`github:3meyc/agent-kit#<ref>`) and call `agent-kit ledger-scan-secrets` first.
